title: Navigation & Social Profile Max Recall Combo Update (v0.4.17)
message: Removed obsolete Back to Menu button, guaranteed floating bubble overlay remains suppressed on Back to Home, and replaced mastered vocabulary with Max Recall Quiz Combo in social student profiles.
changelog:
• Removed 'Back to Menu' Button: Cleaned up the quiz completion screen to avoid confusing dual-exit buttons.
• Zero Bubble on Exit: Defensively suppressed floating bubble overlay when returning to Home across all quiz, reading, and history activities.
• Social Student Profile Upgrade: Replaced Mastered Words chips with real-time Max Recall Quiz Combo benchmark and streak badges in student profiles.
• Verified zero compile errors and synchronized graph.
